name: select
title: Select
description: UI SDK Select: trigger, popup list, items with a check indicator, groups and separators, or `options` as data with a clearable none choice. Works inside Field; agents choose by label.
docs: Pass `options` (`{ value, label, disabled?, description? }[]`, or groups `{ label, options }[]`) and leave out children: the trigger, list, groups and indicators render for you, and the labels are known before the list opens. `placeholder` shows while nothing is selected. `clearable="No team"` adds a first choice with that label that sets the value to `null` (single selects only). `size="sm"` gives the trigger a compact fixed height for toolbars and filters (keep `default` with a floating label), and `triggerProps` (`id`, `className`, `data-*`, `size`, which wins) go to the trigger. `SelectTrigger size` does the same with parts. Outside a Field, name it with `aria-label`. With children, the parts API works as before, and `options` still feeds the root's `items`.
